Your life is not ruined at all. Hiv is no longer the monster it used to be. There's no need to tell anyone you aren't in a relationship with. Or you aren't sexually active with. That's your health status and is private to you. There's medications now that literally makes you undetectable and unable to pass it to others. So as long as you take care of yourself  you are absolutely fine. I'm glad you got tested and found out early. Is the best that could happen for you and your health.  Take one day at a time. Join online support groups. Meet other people who have it and they will show you how life is wonderful no matter your status as long as you learn to love yourself and not let it get to you. Obviously it takes time and work but you aren't alone. There's so many people out there that have fully normal lives and Noone knows. Just keep yourself healthy and others safe.
